dataset.name: ClinicalTrials.gov completed drug trials · 101,135 source records
dataset.source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 · complete frozen completed interventional DRUG / Phase I–IV scope

warnings: Registry snapshots are retrospective unless baseline feature provenance is established.
106709 date values have month/year precision; preserve that uncertainty when interpreting durations.
Records without exact day-precision ACTUAL start/completion dates, valid ordering, and required outcomes are not duration-training labels.
PCI displays missing components as zero burden; inspect missingness before comparing scores.
Acquired record counts are not model training or evaluation counts; use each model report for eligible records and split support.

provenance.dataset_name: ClinicalTrials.gov completed interventional drug-trial registry cohort
provenance.query: AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND AREA[OverallStatus]COMPLETED AND AREA[InterventionType]DRUG AND (AREA[Phase]PHASE1 OR AREA[Phase]PHASE2 OR AREA[Phase]PHASE3 OR AREA[Phase]PHASE4)
provenance.sampling_method: All returned records in the frozen official query, ordered by source start date, until pagination ends or declared maximum. Source availability/changes may affect coverage.
provenance.date_policy: Preserve exact/year/month source strings and ACTUAL/ESTIMATED types; no date imputation.
provenance.enrollment_policy: planned_enrollment uses only explicitly ESTIMATED enrollment; reported/current enrollment is not an original plan.
provenance.eligibility_feature_method: Lexical nonempty-line, Unicode-word and character counts from eligibility text; not counts of clinical conditions.
provenance.site_policy: Counts refer to locations/countries present in this current source projection; not planned sites or recruitment performance.
provenance.data_use: Public ClinicalTrials.gov registry records; cite the source and review its terms. No blanket third-party text license is asserted.
limitations: Current snapshots do not prove trial-start feature availability.
Completed-only drug-trial scope omits censored outcomes and does not represent all trials.
No patient-level data, original planned completion, treatment benefit or clinical validation is inferred.
First-registered date is not a timestamp for every current feature.
Counts are an acquisition inventory; training eligibility and temporal purging must be reported separately.
provenance.source_identity_method: SHA-256 of the immutable acquisition metadata, which contains raw response and canonical shard checksums.
provenance.canonical_identity_method: SHA-256 of ordered canonical shard file/hash/row-count descriptors in sorted-key compact JSON.
